name: Select an implementation while the program runs
scoped_purpose: Use for choosing, inside a running program that depends on the esoi package, which implementation of a solution serves a call, by name, override or table default, and for refusing an unknown name with the valid choices. Avoids deciding which implementation is best (the leaderboard does) and avoids per-call branching in the program that embeds it.
goals: Switching is a data change made while the program is deployed; an unknown name fails with the choices; targets load lazily so an embedding program pays only for what it selects.
knowledge: Ports and adapters; plugin registries; how libraries let an embedding program declare and select alternatives at run time.
measures_of_success: Every switch works from configuration alone, no typo falls back silently, and a program that embeds the package selects an implementation without reading this repository.
inputs: A selection table of module:Attribute targets.
outputs: The chosen class or factory, and its config class.
usage_notes: Keep the table default equal to the measured winner or a declared tie.
selected_by: the only implementation built; its cases pin the behaviour any rival must keep
invariant_reason: A name resolves as specified or it does not.
